name: Legal Dock
summary: A classic or Mac-style dock for Hyprland and Omarchy with a real minimize button, magnifying icons, and lock/hide/transparency controls
description:
Legal Dock is a classic or Mac-style dock for Hyprland and Omarchy with two styles you can switch between with one click: Classic (the nwg-dock-hyprland dock) or Mac (a magnifying, macOS-style dock built with Quickshell, with running apps, a right-click menu, and middle-click to pin).

It adds a menu with Small/Medium/Large icon sizes, a lock for icon order, auto-hide, full-width and transparent modes, an app drawer button, and a confirm-before-reboot button.

Mac touches include a Rubik's Cube launcher that scrambles as you open windows, a New Incognito Window option on right-click for most browsers, launch-bounce animation, and Mac-style window animations (spring-open, shrink-and-fade close, minimize-to-dock).

Hyprland has no native minimize; Legal Dock adds a real one that parks windows on a hidden workspace and restores them from the dock.

Developed by 5ive7 Development Labs. MIT licensed.
notes: Packaged and mirrored by the Omarchy Store after review (license, package contents, no install hooks or outbound network calls). Source: https://github.com/5ive7/legal-dock

featured.headline: A real dock for Hyprland.
featured.tagline: Switch between a classic dock and a magnifying Mac-style dock in one click. Legal Dock adds the minimize button Hyprland never had, plus size, lock, auto-hide and transparency controls.

features.title: Two docks, one click
features.body: Classic (nwg-dock-hyprland) or a magnifying macOS-style dock built with Quickshell, with running apps, a right-click menu and middle-click to pin. Switch any time from the dock menu.

features.title: Minimize, finally
features.body: Hyprland has no minimize. Legal Dock adds one: windows park on a hidden workspace and come back with a click on their dock icon. Bind it to a key or a title-bar button.

features.title: Small, Medium or Large
features.body: Pick your icon size from the dock menu, lock the icon order so nothing moves, and go full width if you like.

features.title: Hide or go see-through
features.body: Auto-hide the dock until you need it, or make it transparent so your wallpaper shows through.

features.title: No accidental reboots
features.body: Restart and Shut down live in the dock menu and always ask “Do you really want to…?” first.

features.title: Mac touches
features.body: Launch bounce, New Incognito Window on browser icons, a Rubik's Cube launcher that scrambles as you open windows, and optional Mac-style window animations.

features.title: Pins and colours that stick
features.body: Pin apps with a middle-click and lock their order. Your colours live in your own style.css, which updates never overwrite.

steps.title: Get it
steps.body: Press GET in the Omarchy Store app and type your password when asked.

steps.title: Start it at login
steps.body: Add “legal-dock start” to your Hyprland autostart (on Omarchy: ~/.config/hypr/autostart.lua).

steps.title: Pick your style
steps.body: Open Legal Dock from the launcher (Super + Space) or run “legal-dock menu”, then choose Classic or Mac.

faq.a: No. Legal Dock is a dock for your apps; your Omarchy top bar stays as it is.

faq.q: Where are my pinned apps stored?
faq.a: In ~/.cache/nwg-dock-pinned, one app per line. Your colours are in ~/.config/nwg-dock-hyprland/style.css and are never overwritten.

faq.q: Can it do the macOS genie effect?
faq.a: Hyprland can't do a true genie animation. Legal Dock ships Mac-style spring-open, shrink-and-fade close and slide-to-dock minimize animations instead.
5ive7 Development Labs, an independent developer. The Omarchy Store reviewed the package (licence, contents, no install scripts or network calls) before listing it. MIT licence, provided as is.
